title: Further than anyone has been
prose: The pilgrims are walking to a shrine further than any of them has been. None of them can say exactly where it is; the oldest of them walked part of the way as a girl and turned back. They will know it when they see it, she says. That is how a shrine works.

choices.label: Ask what the shrine is for
choices.line: For arriving at, she says, and laughs at your face. Then she tells you, properly, and it takes until the fire is embers.

choices.label: Wish them a good road
choices.line: They take the wish seriously, all of them, and say it back to you one by one.

notes: A fireside story for a night slept beside a camp of pilgrims (Roads and Hands, phase 5). Shared by every map, as the owner's four camp kinds are. Drafted for the owner to rewrite or approve.
